name: Lesha Industries Limited
about: Lesha Industries Limited trades in steel, chemicals, and other ancillary products in India. It operates through Steel Trading; Trading of Goods; Shares/Commodity Trading; and Others segments. The company was formerly known as Technocorp Infosystems Limited and changed its name to Lesha Industries Limited in August 2009. Lesha Industries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
